bio.text: Pat Billie Miller has represented Stamford and parts of Darien in the Connecticut Senate since 2021.
Before that she served in the House of Representatives from 2009 to 2021, representing Stamford's 145th Assembly District.
She is Senate chair of the Banking Committee and chaired the legislature's Black and Puerto Rican Caucus from 2023 through 2024.
